personality_one_liner: A retro-inspired, dark-themed command center for capturing stereotypical creatures around Bologna, blending tactical mobile utility with 8-bit nostalgia.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing around map controls to prevent accidental touches. Thick retro borders instead of soft shadows.

dont's: No glassmorphism. This is a retro 8-bit style dark utility UI. Use solid backgrounds with thick borders.

screens.name: Title Screen
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a top gradient scrim to dark. Huge retro display font for the title 'Bologna Monstri'. Sticky buttons at the bottom. The UI should have 2pt strong borders reflecting brutalist/retro influence.

screens.name: Map Overworld
screens.purpose: The main exploration screen across 5 Italian towns with D-pad controls.
screens.layout: Top info band (15% height) showing Player Team health and current Town (Bologna, Imola, etc.). Center (flex: 1) is the tile map rendering. Bottom area (30% height) contains a large D-pad on the left (25% screen width) and A/B interact context buttons on the right. Solid dark backgrounds for control areas, separating them clearly from the map.

screens.name: Battle Screen
screens.purpose: Turn-based combat encounter with wild monsters or NPCs.
screens.layout: Top area: Opponent info (HP bar, Name). Center: Battle visual scene. Bottom area: A sticky command center using a 2x2 grid for Actions: 'Lotta' (Attack), 'Cattura' (Catch), 'Mostri' (Switch), 'Fuga' (Flee). Tapping 'Lotta' opens a slide-in bottom sheet with 4 specific moves. High contrast, sharp corners, instant transitions.

screens.name: Mostrario
screens.purpose: Bestiary showing captured Italian stereotypical monsters.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of a notebook: 'Nessun mostro catturato. Esplora l'Emilia-Romagna!'

screens.layout: Grid list (2 columns) of captured monsters. Each card has a surfaceSecondary background, a 1pt border, and a center monster icon. A sticky filter bar at the top.

title_background.alt: Retro 8-bit game console scene in dark lighting

instructions_to_main_agent: Build an ORIGINAL monster-collecting tile-map RPG named 'Bologna Monstri'. Do NOT use any Nintendo IP or copyrighted names. Generate unique local Italian stereotypical characters and creatures based around Bologna, Imola, Ferrara, etc.
Use 'Space Mono' or a system monospace font to emulate a modern pixel aesthetic without relying on external font files if they fail to load.

The UI should follow a 'Dark-First Utility' style mixed with brutalist 8-bit retro vibes. DO NOT use rounded corners (radius > 8), and absolutely no glassmorphism or blur. Use solid dark backgrounds (#121212) with contrasting thick borders (#333333 or #555555).
NO BLUE OR PURPLE ALLOWED. Stick strictly to the provided color palette (Dark Charcoal, Deep Crimson, Warning Yellow, Saturated Green).
Implement a D-Pad control system on the bottom left of the Map Overworld screen. Ensure the hit targets are at least 56x56pt for comfortable mobile gaming.

Battle Screen must be turn-based: Layout the commands 'Lotta' (Attack), 'Cattura' (Catch), 'Mostri' (Switch), and 'Fuga' (Flee) in a sticky bottom container. They should be large, thumb-friendly buttons.
Apply 'gradient-to-dark scrim' on any image backgrounds (like the Title Screen) to guarantee readability for overlying text.
Wire haptics on all D-Pad movements and battle action clicks as specified.
